title: Office & Commercial Movers in Anaheim | SOS Moving
metaDescription: Anaheim Canyon units, Resort-area suites and warehouse offices: office movers in Anaheim for staged moves, with lift and dock hours booked ahead.
heroSubtitle: Business moves planned around your dock hours, elevator booking and the paperwork your property manager signs

faq.question: Does our Anaheim office need a city permit for the moving truck?
faq.answer: A permit only comes into it when the truck works from the kerb; where your building has its own dock, the city is not involved. Anaheim’s Traffic Engineering Division takes transportation permit applications online and publishes a Truck Route Map with the conditions, and says online submissions are processed within 24 hours. After the walkthrough we tell you whether your address needs one.

faq.question: Can you move our office over a weekend?
faq.answer: Yes. Crews run Monday through Sunday, and a Saturday or Sunday stage is the usual way to keep a business open during the week. The working window is 8AM – 6PM every day, so the plan is built around daylight hours rather than an overnight shift, and a big floor is split into two or three weekend stages.

faq.question: What does the certificate of insurance cost, and who receives it?
faq.answer: A certificate of insurance is $50 and is issued in the name your lease gives for the property manager, with the limits and additional insured wording the building asks for. We send it before the lift and the loading bay are reserved, because most managers will not release a slot without it. Both addresses can be covered when you are moving between two managed buildings.

faq.question: How many hours should we budget for a small Anaheim office?
faq.answer: That comes out of the walkthrough: the number of desks, what has to come apart, and how far the truck parks from the lift. Every booking carries a three-hour minimum, which becomes four hours once you are 30 miles or more out from our base. Travel counts double past ten miles, and overtime rates start after the eighth hour on site.

faq.question: Can you handle warehouse racking and heavy shop equipment as well as desks?
faq.answer: Yes, and most mixed premises here move both at once. Anything over 300 lbs is priced at $150 and goes with a crew of three, a second truck is $200 when one body will not hold the load, and a loaded truck held overnight is $200 if the new unit is not ready on the day. Tell us which machines have to work first and they travel first.

faq.question: Do you take same-day bookings for business moves?
faq.answer: When a crew is free, yes, and that is often what saves a lease deadline or a handover date. A staged relocation still works better booked a week or two out, because the lift, the loading bay and the certificate of insurance all take a little lead time. The number for a same-day check is 909-443-0004.
